purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Import Depot Activity Empty Return Advice - GR details.
features: This function allows the user to generate Empty Return Advice right fax for Greece Location only.
Empty Return Location cannot be Empty

events.description: Generates the Empty Return Advice for the selected BL records and shows it as a PDF.
events.triggered_when: User selects one or more BL records using the check boxes, clicks the ☰ icon at Voyage level in Depot Activity and selects "Empty Return Advice-GR".
